description_en: Queries the route information of an IPsec-VPN connection by calling the DescribeVcoRouteEntries operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeVcoRouteEntries接口查询IPsec连接下路由条目的信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vco-route-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-connection-id vco-p0w2jpkhi2eeop6q60000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVcoRouteEntries

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection
parameters.name: vpn_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the route. Valid values:

custom (default): destination route.
bgp: BGP route
parameters.help_zh:
路由条目类型。取值：

custom（默认值）：目的路由条目。
bgp：BGP路由条目
parameters.name: route_entry_type

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。默认值：10。取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for paging queries
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

AsPath.description_en: The list of autonomous system (AS) numbers that the BGP route passes through
AsPath.description_zh: BGP路由条目经过的自治系统号列表

Community.description_en: The community value carried by the BGP route

CreateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the destination route was created.

The timestamp is in the UNIX format and represents the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
CreateTime.description_zh:
创建目的路由条目的时间戳。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建目的路由条目时的总时长

NextHop.description_en: The next hop of the route

NextHopTunnelIdList.description_en:
The list of next-hop tunnels.

This information is returned only for IPsec-VPN connections in dual-tunnel mode.
Tunnel information is returned only when the tunnel status is Phase 2 negotiations succeeded
NextHopTunnelIdList.description_zh:
下一跳隧道列表。

仅双隧道模式的IPsec连接会返回该信息。
仅隧道状态为第二阶段协商成功时，接口才会返回隧道信息

RouteDest.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route

RouteEntryType.description_en:
The type of the route.

custom: The route is a destination route.
bgp: The route is a BGP route
RouteEntryType.description_zh:
路由条目类型。

custom：表示当前路由条目为目的路由条目。
bgp：表示当前路由条目为BGP路由条目

Source.description_en:
The source of the BGP route.

CLOUD: The BGP route is learned by the IPsec-VPN connection from the transit router.
VPN_BGP: The BGP route is learned by the IPsec-VPN connection from the on-premises data center
Source.description_zh:
BGP路由条目的来源。

CLOUD：表示当前BGP路由条目是IPsec连接通过转发路由器学习到的。
VPN_BGP：表示当前BGP路由条目是IPsec连接从本地数据中心学习到的

State.description_en:
The status of the route.

published: The destination route has been published to the transit router instance.
Active: The BGP route is available
State.description_zh:
路由条目的状态。

published：表示当前目的路由条目已发布至转发路由器实例中。
Active：表示当前BGP路由条目可用

VpnConnectionId.description_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection

Weight.description_en:
The weight of the destination route.

This parameter is not in use
Weight.description_zh:
目的路由条目的权重值。

当前参数无实际作用

VpnRouteCounts.description_en:
The route statistics for the IPsec-VPN connection in dual-tunnel mode.

This information is returned only for IPsec-VPN connections in dual-tunnel mode
VpnRouteCounts.description_zh:
双隧道模式IPsec连接的路由条目统计信息。

仅双隧道模式的IPsec连接会返回该组信息

RouteEntryType.description_en:
The type of the route.

custom: destination route.
bgp: BGP route
RouteEntryType.description_zh:
路由条目类型。

custom：目的路由条目。
bgp：BGP路由条目

Source.description_en:
The source of the BGP route.

CLOUD: The BGP route is learned by the IPsec-VPN connection from the transit router.
VPN_BGP: The BGP route is learned by the IPsec-VPN connection from the on-premises data center
Source.description_zh:
BGP路由条目的来源。

CLOUD：表示当前BGP路由条目是IPsec连接通过转发路由器学习到的。
VPN_BGP：表示当前BGP路由条目是IPsec连接从本地数据中心学习到的
